name: suede-campaign-in-a-box
description: Suede AI artist campaign rollout for a song, release, era, show, or catalog moment. Use when an artist needs a complete campaign across surfaces (identity, era world, hooks, release stunts, fan rituals, visualizers, merch, setlists, catalog revival, collaborator outreach) or the full announce, tease, release-week, and post-drop package with calendar, email, site copy, search-ready release page, and fan actions. Picks one of twelve lanes or stitches them together, and flags rights gaps instead of
